--lightness-hover.deprecated: Interaction fragments now contain mode-specific values directly. Retained for compatibility; remove in 1.0.0.

--lightness-press.deprecated: Interaction fragments now contain mode-specific values directly. Retained for compatibility; remove in 1.0.0.

--alpha-hover.deprecated: Interaction fragments now contain mode-specific values directly. Retained for compatibility; remove in 1.0.0.

--alpha-press.deprecated: Interaction fragments now contain mode-specific values directly. Retained for compatibility; remove in 1.0.0.

--interaction-standard-hover.light: calc(l - 0.03 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / calc(alpha + 0.04)
--interaction-standard-hover.dark: calc(l + 0.03 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / calc(alpha + 0.03)

--interaction-standard-pressed.light: calc(l - 0.06 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / calc(alpha + 0.08)
--interaction-standard-pressed.dark: calc(l + 0.06 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / calc(alpha + 0.06)

--interaction-inverse-hover.light: calc(l + 0.03 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / alpha
--interaction-inverse-hover.dark: calc(l - 0.03 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / alpha

--interaction-inverse-pressed.light: calc(l + 0.06 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / alpha
--interaction-inverse-pressed.dark: calc(l - 0.06 * clamp(1,(.5 - l)/.1,3)) c h / alpha
